A twice-corrupted Alpha's Howl (+20-30 Spirit, or an extra socket) is also worth considering (per the source guide).
詠唱速度+55%の条件を満たす前にヴィレンタの推進力へ替えると火力が落ちる。条件: Switching to Vilenta's Propulsion before meeting the +55% cast speed requirement lowers your damage. Confirm the requirement first (per the source guide).
ザロクの贈り物への注入変更と生贄のレガリアなど、Min-Max構成の装備が揃う。: You have the Min-Max gear ready, including switching the anointment to Zarokh's Gift and Sacrificial Regalia.
ウルフパック（Wolf Pack）をゴーストダンス（Ghost Dance）かス: Replace Wolf Pack with Ghost Dance or Skeletal Sniper to optimise Spirit. Add Khatal's Rejuvenation to Into the Breach (skippable if it is too expensive). Snapshotting Remnants (entering the zone on weapon set II) adds another 20-30% damage, but the source guide treats it as a fully optional, advanced optimisation (per the source guide).
電気の狂信者／カオスゼロットの狂乱の餌付け II（Feeding Frenzy: Swap Feeding Frenzy II on the Powered Zealot/Chaos Zealot for Dialla's Desire, and Lightning Attunement on the Skeletal Storm Mage for Esh's Radiance. Add Atziri's Communion to Blasphemy or Convalescence (per the source guide).
アミュレットへの注入はザロクの贈り物（Zarokh's Gift）。闇の右腕（R: Anoint the amulet with Zarokh's Gift. If you get a Megalomaniac with Right Hand of Darkness, respec the pathing to it (per the source guide).
生贄のレガリア（Sacrificial Regalia）が正しいModで揃えば最: Sacrificial Regalia is the best body armour when it has the right mods. For Alpha's Howl, the completed form is a 2-socket one with Legacy of Greymake, either corrupted with +1 to all Minion Skill Levels or twice-corrupted with +25-30 Spirit. Mageblood is an alternative to the rare belt (per the source guide).
スナップショット用のツリーでスナップショットをしないと総ダメージの約50%を失う: The source guide warns that if you use the snapshot tree without snapshotting, you lose about 50% of total damage. If you will not snapshot, stay on the regular tree. The fourth Ascendancy point is 'completely useless' according to the source guide, so there is no rush to take it (per the source guide).
完成形。以降はジュエルとコラプトの厳選が中心になる。: Completed. From here on, it is about refining jewels and corruptions.
バインドスペクターで縛ったスペクターを主力にするミニオン軍団構成。キャンペーン終: A minion army build whose main damage comes from Spectres bound with Bind Spectre. Late in the campaign a bomb-throwing Vaal Guard carries the damage; from mapping onward, Powered Zealot/Chaos Zealot Spectres casting Spark take over, while Waking Dream's violet flame is passed to the minions with Selfless Remnants to stack added chaos damage.
ワーリングスラッシュ（Whirling Slash）で風の渦を3重まで重ね、ツイ: Stack up to 3 whirlwinds with Whirling Slash, then consume them with Twister to empower it. Early on, parry with a buckler, then use Fangs of Frost to create chilled ground.
ワーリングスラッシュ（Whirling Slash）はLv1維持：アタックスピー: Whirling Slash stays at level 1: Rapid Attacks I, then Rage I. Twister: Retreat, then Prolonged Duration I. Ice-Tipped Arrows: Elemental Armament I. War Banner: Prolonged Duration I. Also use Frost Bomb. From the source planner (Campaign).
原典の「Campaign」ツリーに沿う。属性は装備とジェムの要求を満たす分を取り: Follow the source's 'Campaign' tree. Take attributes only as far as gear and gem requirements demand, and put the rest into Strength for Life. Weapon-set point allocation starts in Act 2.
武器セット1は攻撃速度最優先のスピア（翼刃のスピア（Winged Spear）か: Weapon set 1: an attack-speed-first spear (a Winged Spear or Soaring Spear with an attack speed suffix; Skysliver if you have one). Keep the off hand empty to benefit from Dance with Death. Weapon set 2: a damage-focused spear. For armour in Acts 1-3, prioritise armour to reduce hits taken while parrying.
フレッシュリーグでLv1からツイスターで育てるには、ハントレスのミュールキャラを: To level with Twister from level 1 in a fresh league, first make a Huntress mule character and pass a level 1 Whirling Slash, a spear and a buckler through the stash. Without a mule, level with Lightning Arrow + Lightning Rod and switch around level 10, once you have three level 3 gems and a decent spear. The source strongly insists on keeping Whirling Slash at level 1: levelling it only raises its mana cost. For movement the source recommends WASD controls; with mouse controls you must keep the cursor close to your character, which is awkward.
Act 2到達と、最初のLv2アンカットサポートジェムでフロストネクサス（Fro: Reach Act 2 and cut Frost Nexus with your first level 2 uncut support gem.
ツイスター（Twister）＋ワーリングスラッシュ（Whirling Slash: The basic Twister + Whirling Slash rotation. Generate frenzy charges while moving with Cull the Weak, and freeze tough enemies with Freezing Mark.
ツイスター（Twister）：後退（Retreat）→フロストネクサス（Fros: Twister: Retreat, Frost Nexus, then Elemental Armament II. Ice-Tipped Arrows: Elemental Armament I, then Magnified Area I. Barrage: Rapid Casting, then Perpetual Charge. Cull the Weak: Thrill of the Kill II, then Charge Profusion. Freezing Mark: Prolonged Duration I. Herald of Ice: Elemental Armament II, then Magnified Area II. From the source planner (Maps).
武器セットのポイント配分をAct 2から始める。武器セット1はワーリングスラッシ: Start allocating weapon-set points in Act 2. Weapon set 1 is for Whirling Slash and Barrage; weapon set 2 holds everything else. Ice-Tipped Arrows must go in weapon set 2, or it will not work. Take Gathering Winds, then Avidity, as your first ascendancy points to boost frenzy charge generation.
2つ目のアンカットスピリットジェム（Lv6）を取ったらお告げのセプター（Omen: Once you take your second uncut spirit gem (level 6), switch to an Omen Sceptre. Keep prioritising armour on your gear, though from Act 3 onward you will also want evasion. On jewellery and gloves, prioritise added damage to attacks (flat damage).
フロストネクサス（Frost Nexus）を切ったら、冷気の地面はそちらが作るの: Once Frost Nexus is socketed, it creates the chilled ground, so you can drop Fangs of Frost. Use Ice-Tipped Arrows on cooldown to convert your damage to cold and freeze enemies. Use Cull the Weak to generate frenzy charges while moving, and fire a frenzy-empowered Barrage into rare and magic packs. Against bosses, Freezing Mark creates ice ground together with Frost Nexus.
Act 3到達と、ヘラルドオブアイス（Herald of Ice）の切り出し。: Reach Act 3 and cut Herald of Ice.
Act 3〜キャンペーン終了（ヘラルドオブアイス）: Act 3 to campaign completion (Herald of Ice)
基本ローテーション（アイスティップアロー→ワーリングスラッシュ3回→バラージ→ツ: Herald of Ice explosions join the basic rotation (Ice-Tipped Arrows, then three Whirling Slashes, Barrage, then Twister).
ツイスター（Twister）：後退（Retreat）→フロストネクサス（Fros: Twister: keep Retreat, Frost Nexus and Elemental Armament II. Extend Herald of Ice to Elemental Armament II, Magnified Area II and Elemental Focus. Link Charge Profusion to Combat Frenzy. See the source planner for the exact sockets.
3つ目のアセンダンシーはスリリングな追跡（Thrilling Chase）。回避: Take Thrilling Chase as your third ascendancy point. Once you have a body armour with 1200+ evasion rating, start taking deflection nodes such as The Wild Cat, Trained Deflection and Enhanced Reflexes. Projectile speed, skill effect duration and area of effect all multiply Twister's damage.
Act 3以降は回避が欲しくなる。防具はライフと耐性を最優先に、アーマーと回避を: From Act 3 onward you will want evasion. On armour, prioritise Life and resistances above all, combining armour and evasion. Put a high-physical-damage spear in weapon set 2.
ヘラルドオブアイス（Herald of Ice）を切ると殲滅が大きく楽になるので: Cutting Herald of Ice makes clearing much easier, so do not skip cutting its support slots. If Whirling Slash struggles to crit the marked target, check Pinpoint Critical and Inexorable Critical II, and the Rune of Consistency on your helmet.
キャンペーン終了とマップ到達。: Finish the campaign and reach maps.
ツイスター（Twister）＋バラージ（Barrage）のサルヴォ（Salvo）: The Twister + Barrage combo with Salvo. Called Shots automatically applies Sniper's Mark to generate frenzy charges.
ツイスター（Twister）：後退（Retreat）→フロストネクサス（Fros: Twister: Retreat, Frost Nexus, Elemental Armament II, Acceleration, then Deliberation. Barrage: Perpetual Charge, Rapid Casting II, then Heightened Charges. Fire Salvo only after building 4+ seals. Called Shots' Sniper's Mark: Charged Mark, Eternal Mark, Ingenuity, then Charge Profusion. See the source planner for the exact sockets.
4つ目のアセンダンシーはコールショット（Called Shots）。凍結の呪印（: Take Called Shots as your fourth ascendancy point. Swap Freezing Mark for Sniper's Mark and extend frenzy generation with Eternal Mark (only once your critical chance is high enough to spend the charges reliably). Deflection nodes become a serious investment once you have a 1500+ evasion body armour.
破滅の軌跡（Wake of Destruction）で元素の地面を作り、フロスト: Wake of Destruction creates elemental ground so you no longer need Frost Nexus. Your top purchase is The Taming, which keeps Twister empowered even without elemental ground. Serpent's Egg is good for boosting frenzy charge generation. Cover your mana with sapphires that recover 2% mana on kill.
ツイスター（Twister）を撃ちすぎないこと。サルヴォ（Salvo）とバラージ: Do not fire Twister too often. The source instructs you to wait until the Salvo + Barrage combo is stacked, then fire. Once Called Shots applies the mark, trigger it twice with Whirling Slash to generate up to 4 frenzy charges. Against bosses, build 4-6 frenzy charges first, then unleash the Salvo + Barrage + Twister combo.
テイミング（The Taming）の入手と、オルロスの信念（Olroth's C: Obtain The Taming, and be in a position to obtain Olroth's Conviction.
ツイスター（Twister）＋バラージ（Barrage）のクリティカル構成。スピ: The critical Twister + Barrage setup. Generate power charges with Spear Stab + Ailith's Chimes and extend them with Charge Regulation.
バラージ（Barrage）：チャージ温存（Perpetual Charge）→キ: Barrage: Perpetual Charge, Rapid Casting II, Heightened Charges, Cooldown Recovery II, then Efficiency II. Twister: Retreat, Acceleration, Rakiata's Flow, Deliberation, then Salvo. Once you equip Olroth's Conviction, remove Salvo from Twister. Whirling Slash: Rapid Attacks III, Rage III, Pinpoint Critical, Inexorable Critical II, then Blazing Critical. Spear Stab: Culmination II, Ailith's Chimes, Charge Profusion, Rapid Attacks III, then Rage III. See the source planner for the exact sockets.
クリティカル系ノードと回避／受け流しノードのバランスを取る。受け流しノードは回避: Balance critical nodes with evasion and deflection nodes. Deflection nodes become a serious investment with a 1500+ evasion body armour. Use Heart of the Well's 'gain damage as fire' to balance Trinity. Put '% increased Energy Shield' on your rare sapphires.
最優先はオルロスの信念（Olroth's Conviction）で、バラージ（B: Top priority is Olroth's Conviction, which lets you use Barrage 3 times per cooldown. Your weapon should be a high-physical-damage spear. Aim for 10%+ critical chance on The Ordained. For your sceptre, Sacred Flame gives the most damage, but mind its interaction with Rakiata's Flow. For Trinity balance, choose from Guiding Palm of the Eye, Guiding Palm of the Heart or Guiding Palm of the Mind. Uhtred's Sidereus and Runeforged Sekhema Sandals are also candidates.
聖なる炎（Sacred Flame）とラキアタの流れ（Rakiata's Flo: If you use Sacred Flame together with Rakiata's Flow, keep the boss away from you when firing Twister (they cancel each other out). Trinity has a breakpoint at level 23 for '+1% more elemental damage', so reach it with Uhtred's Augury or Uhtred's Omen. Garukhan's Resolve is the strongest lineage support for damage.
メイジブラッド（Mageblood）やヘッドハンター（Headhunter）など: Reach the point where you can spend currency on expensive completed-build gear such as Mageblood or Headhunter.
ツイスター（Twister）＋バラージ（Barrage）の完成形。バーサーク（B: The completed Twister + Barrage setup. The final configuration adds Berserk and Ghost Dance.
ツイスター（Twister）：後退（Retreat）→加速（Accelerati: Twister: Retreat, Acceleration, Rakiata's Flow, Garukhan's Resolve, then Deliberation. Barrage: Perpetual Charge, Heightened Charges, Olroth's Conviction, Uhtred's Constellation, then Efficiency II. Whirling Slash: Rapid Attacks III, Heightened Accuracy II, Blazing Critical, Pinpoint Critical, then Rigwald's Ferocity. Herald of Thunder: Elemental Armament II, Concentrated Area, Blindside, Esh's Radiance, then Esh's Prowess. See the source planner for the exact sockets.
ラヴィアンガの心（Lavianga's Spirits）で効率的なフラスクノード: Take efficient flask nodes with Lavianga's Spirits. Beastial Skin is strong on an evasion body armour (it pairs well with Slipstrike Vest or Sleek Jacket). Choose a Controlled Metamorphosis with a small penalty to all elemental resistances (important when using Headhunter). Socket only good Time-Lost Jewels. If you have a good Megalomaniac, take extra jewel sockets toward the Shadow/Witch side.
メイジブラッド（Mageblood）は銀・翡翠・ビスマスのレガシーを2倍化したも: For Mageblood, the best is one that doubles Silver, Jade and Bismuth legacies. Headhunter is extremely strong in rare-dense content, but makes resistances and chaos resistance harder to cover. Kolr's Hunt marksman gloves are a luxury item. Uhtred's Sidereus, Runeforged Sekhema Sandals, Legacy of Wanderlust and Absent Amulet are also completed-build candidates.
マナ問題が出たらキル時にマナ2%回復のサファイアとマナフラスク、終盤はラヴィアン: If mana becomes a problem, use sapphires that recover 2% mana on kill and a mana flask; in the late game, use Lavianga's Spirits. Pure evasion or an ES/evasion hybrid is a matter of taste: the hybrid is somewhat tankier but leaves less freedom in the tree. The source warns that 'you are fragile while waiting for cooldowns in boss fights'.
完成形。以後はジュエルの3モッド化と各装備の最大ロール化、タイムロストジュエルの: Completed build. From here, work on 3-mod jewels, max rolls on each piece of gear, and strict Time-Lost Jewel selection.
クォータースタッフで最初の2〜3レベルを進め、間に合わせのクロスボウ（Renly: Progress through the first 2-3 levels with a quarterstaff, then switch to Explosive Grenade and Flash Grenade once you have a Makeshift Crossbow (buyable from Renly). Use Frost Bomb to apply Exposure and War Banner to raise boss damage.
エクスプローシブグレネードにマルチショット II（Multishot II）と元: Socket Explosive Grenade with Multishot II and Elemental Armament I, Flash Grenade with Multishot II and Lightning Attunement, and Frost Bomb with Rapid Casting I. Into the Breach unlocks after taking the first Ascendancy (Remnant Potency II and Harmonic Remnants II).
衝撃の一撃（Concussive Attack）、眩暈の薙ぎ払い（Dizzyin: Take Concussive Attack, Dizzying Sweep, Killer Instinct, Blinding Strike and Kite Runner to scale grenade damage. Take Ascendancy points in the order Waking Dream, then Choice of Power (per the source guide).
物理／雷ダメージの高いクロスボウ（Act 3で爆撃のクロスボウへ）。最大ライフと: Prioritise a crossbow with high flat physical and lightning damage (switch to a Bombard Crossbow in Act 3). Prioritise maximum Life and resistances; an armour or armour/evasion base is preferable, as the source guide notes evasion-only armour feels rough early on. Pick up any helmet, amulet or sceptre with +1 to Minion Skills you come across for the late Act 3 transition.
モンクのAct 1序盤は厳しい区間と原典が述べる。エクスプローシブグレネード解禁: The source guide notes that the early Act 1 stretch is rough for Monks. Do not overextend before Explosive Grenade unlocks. Pick up rares and sell them to start saving gold for the respec.
Act 3終盤のウトザールに到達し、ヴァールガード・スペクターを束縛できる（Lv: Reach Utzaal late in Act 3, where you can bind a Vaal Guard Spectre (around level 38).
Lv38〜41（ミニオンへ切替：ヴァールガード・スペクター）: Levels 38-41 (Switching to Minions: Vaal Guard Spectre)
バインドスペクター（Bind Spectre）で爆弾を投げるヴァールガードを束縛: Bind a bomb-throwing Vaal Guard with Bind Spectre, and summon Raging Spirits with Flame Wall. Empower the minions with Wolf Pack, Pain Offering and Despair.
ヴァールガード・スペクターにマルチショット II（Multishot II）＋狂: Give the Vaal Guard Spectre Multishot II, Feeding Frenzy I and Muster. Give Raging Spirits Last Gasp, Minion Splash I and Feeding Frenzy. Give Pain Offering Meat Shield II and Danse Macabre. Give Into the Breach Remnant Potency II, Harmonic Remnants II and Selfless Remnants.
Lv41〜43前後で約35,000ゴールドのリスペック。容赦ない堕落者（Rele: Respec for about 35,000 gold around levels 41-43. Take Relentless Fallen for minion mobility and damage, Lord of Horrors and The Soul Meridian to reduce Spirit reservation, and Remnant Attraction and Empowering Remnants to strengthen Waking Dream and Choice of Power.
全ミニオンスキルレベル付きのセプター・兜・アミュレット。ラトリングセプターが最適: + to all Minion Skill Levels on your sceptre, helmet and amulet. A Rattling Sceptre is the best base, but the mods matter more than the base (per the source guide). High rolls of added damage to allies in your Presence (fire, cold, lightning or physical) scale damage greatly, as they are multiplied by Choice of Power and Waking Dream.
ヴァールガードは同名のモンスターが3種いる（近接・50スピリット／遠隔・60スピ: There are three same-named Vaal Guard monsters (melee, 50 Spirit; ranged, 60 Spirit; bomb-throwing, 50 Spirit). Bind the bomb-throwing one. The source guide notes that the bomb-throwing Spectre can cause performance issues; if your PC cannot handle it or it bothers you, a Skeletal Reaver can substitute. The source guide states that damage dips below the grenade setup right after the switch.
ヴァールガード・スペクターの束縛とパッシブのリスペック（約35,000ゴールド）: Once the Vaal Guard Spectre is bound and the passive respec (about 35,000 gold) is done, you can enter Act 4 with the minion setup.
最初のグレータージュエラーオーブをスケルトンリーバーに使い、ヴァールガードと置き: Spend the first Greater Jeweller's Orb on Skeletal Reaver and replace the Vaal Guard. Apply shock with a Skeletal Storm Mage and heal with a Skeletal Cleric. Give the minions Onslaught with Refutation, and block to absorb damage in dangerous moments.
スケルトンリーバーに招集（Muster）＋狂乱の餌付け II（Feeding F: Give Skeletal Reaver Muster, Feeding Frenzy II, Last Gasp and Rage III. Give Raging Spirits Muster, Minion Splash II, Feeding Frenzy II and Last Gasp. Give Pain Offering Meat Shield II, Danse Macabre and Elemental Army. Give Refutation Prolonged Duration II and Cooldown Recovery II.
闇の右腕（Right Hand of Darkness）は衰弱（Withered: Take Right Hand of Darkness, because Withered scales strongly with Waking Dream and Choice of Power. Take Necrotised Flesh, Crystalline Flesh and Vile Mending to raise minion survivability. Take Profane Commander to widen Spirit and your Presence radius.
セプター・兜・アミュレットの全ミニオンスキルレベルを維持する。神殿のセプターなら: Keep + to all Minion Skill Levels on your sceptre, helmet and amulet. With a Shrine Sceptre, Spirit reservation supports such as Upwelling II are effectively free (per the source guide). Prioritise boots with movement speed, Life and resistances.
リフュテーションとワードバウンドミニオンは遠征エンカウンター産のスキルジェム。見: Refutation and Wardbound Minions are skill gems from Expedition encounters. Pick them up when you find them. Do not use Wardbound Minions until the Mid setup.
幕間を終えてマップに入る。スケルトンリーバーの構成が整い、リフュテーションを使え: Finish the Interlude and enter maps, with the Skeletal Reaver setup in place and Refutation available.
スケルトンリーバーを主力に、フレイムウォールでレイジングスピリットを出し続ける。: Keep Skeletal Reaver as the main damage dealer and keep summoning Raging Spirits with Flame Wall. Empower the whole army with Pain Offering, and weaken bosses and tough rares with Despair. Use Refutation on cooldown to give the minions Onslaught.
スケルトンリーバーに招集＋狂乱の餌付け II＋死に際＋憤怒 III＋ミニオンスプ: Give Skeletal Reaver Muster, Feeding Frenzy II, Last Gasp, Rage III and Minion Splash II. Give Pain Offering Meat Shield II, Danse Macabre, Magnified Area II and Prolonged Duration II. Give Despair Heightened Curse, Cursed Ground, Efficiency II and Prolonged Duration II. Give Refutation Cooldown Recovery II, Prolonged Duration II, Rapid Casting II and Mobility.
強化バリア（Enhanced Barrier）、注意深い気づき（Mindful: Take Enhanced Barrier, Mindful Awareness and Spectral Ward to raise ES and evasion. Take Heavy Buffer to greatly raise ES and combine it with Mind Over Matter to use mana as a defensive layer. Take Inner Faith and The Hollowkeeper to reduce curse effect by 75%. Take Chayula's Gift as the third Ascendancy.
アルファの遠吠え（Alpha's Howl）が最優先（スピリット大幅増＋プレゼン: Alpha's Howl is the top priority (greatly increased Spirit and doubled Presence radius). Runeforge Enfolding Dawn and use Bones of Ullr to raise the minion count. Prioritise ES on gloves. Anoint the amulet with Essence Infusion.
まず耐性をカンストさせ、属性要求を満たすこと。元素耐性がカンストするまではフラッ: Cap your resistances and meet attribute requirements first, adjusting with Flux runes until elemental resistances are capped. Keeping Wardbound Minions up takes about 100 Ward, so only move to the Mid setup after securing that Ward.
「ミニオンの攻撃に近接スプラッシュ」のレアベルトを入手し、スピリットが450以上: Get a rare belt with 'Minions' attacks deal Melee Splash' and reach 450 or more Spirit.
プレイグハーヴェスター・スペクターに乗り換える。移動が速く障害物を飛び越えるため: Switch to a Plague Harvester Spectre. It moves fast and jumps over obstacles, so it does not get stuck like a Skeletal Reaver. Drop Flame Wall and Raging Spirits, add Wardbound Minions (level 16 at most) and Convalescence, and turn Despair into an aura with Blasphemy.
プレイグハーヴェスター・スペクターに招集＋狂乱の餌付け II＋憤怒 III＋アタ: Give the Plague Harvester Spectre Muster, Feeding Frenzy II, Rage III, Rapid Attacks II and Minion Mastery. Give Pain Offering Danse Macabre, Magnified Area II, Prolonged Duration II, Brutus' Brain and Efficiency II. Give Blasphemy and Despair Ritualistic Curse, Magnified Area II and Chaos Mastery. Give Wardbound Minions Efficiency II, Blind II, Rapid Casting II and Mobility. Give Convalescence Second Wind III, Cooldown Recovery II, Prolonged Duration II and Rapid Casting III.
強力な緩衝材（Heavy Buffer）とマインドオーバーマター（Mind Ov: Use mana as a defensive layer with Heavy Buffer and Mind Over Matter. Anoint the amulet with Warlord Leader. On sapphire jewels, prioritise maximum ES, all elemental resistances for minions, minion attack and cast speed, minion damage, and faster start of Energy Shield Recharge. Optional: specialise weapon set II in Remnant nodes and snapshot by entering the zone on set II and switching to set I, which adds about 20-30% damage (if you skip this, stay on the base tree).
「ミニオンの攻撃に近接スプラッシュ」のレアベルトが必須。体防具と手袋はESと回避: A rare belt with 'Minions' attacks deal Melee Splash' is required. Maximise ES and evasion on body armour and gloves, with Deflection Rating on at least one piece, ideally both. For body armour, use a Rambler Jacket or a Sleek Jacket. Add Spirit with Prism Guardian. Once Spirit passes 450, socket Amanamu's Gaze into your boots for movement speed.
ワードバウンドミニオンは最大Lv16で、低いほどワード消費が少なくて良い。ワード: Wardbound Minions should be level 16 at most — lower is better, as it costs less Ward. Without about 100 Ward you cannot keep Onslaught up. Without the Melee Splash belt, the Spectre loses one support slot.
ESと回避が十分に伸び、コンヴァレッセンスとリフュテーションの運用に慣れる。カタ: Once ES and evasion are high enough and you are comfortable using Convalescence and Refutation, you can add Khatal's Rejuvenation to Into the Breach.
コンヴァレッセンスでESを回復し、リフュテーションで敵の攻撃をブロックしながら、: Recover ES with Convalescence, block enemy attacks with Refutation, and empower the whole army with Pain Offering. For Min-Max, take Bulwark with From Nothing, enable Warlord Berserker with Blood of Rage on a Megalomaniac, and grant the minions Rage with a Blood of the Warrior flask.
プレイグハーヴェスター・スペクターに狂乱の餌付け II＋招集＋ディアーラの欲望（: Give the Plague Harvester Spectre Feeding Frenzy II, Muster, Dialla's Desire, Uul-Netol's Embrace and Minion Splash II (the guide text's instruction; the planner has Rapid Attacks II instead, noted as a discrepancy). Give Pain Offering Danse Macabre, Magnified Area II, Prolonged Duration II, Brutus' Brain and Sacrificial Offering. Give Convalescence Uhtred's Constellation. Give the Skeletal Storm Mage Esh's Radiance.
From Nothing（虚空より来たる）でバルワーク（Bulwark）を取り、: Take Bulwark with From Nothing, plus Warlord Leader, Warlord Berserker and Ally Attack Damage. Use a Megalomaniac with Blood of Rage. On sapphire jewels, prioritise maximum ES, all elemental resistances for minions, minion attack and cast speed, minion damage, minion critical chance and critical damage bonus, and faster start of Energy Shield Recharge.
体防具と手袋はESと回避を最大化し、ディフレクションを付ける。体防具は散策者のジ: Maximise ES and evasion on body armour and gloves, and add Deflection Rating. For body armour, use a Rambler Jacket or a Sleek Jacket. Socket Legacy of Greymake into a 2-socket Alpha's Howl (corrupted with +1 to Minion Skills). Use a high-ES focus (+2 to Minion Skills). If you switch the belt to Mageblood, put Minion Splash II back on the Spectre.
戦士の血フラスコはレイジが最大の時に使うとウォーロードのバーサーカーが発動しない: Using the Blood of the Warrior flask while Rage is full does not trigger Warlord Berserker; use it after Rage has dropped. From 0 Rage, use it in three separate doses to bring the minions to maximum Rage (per the source guide). The source guide states that the fourth Ascendancy point is useless.
完成後はスペクターの厳選とジュエルの更新で伸ばす。ピナクルボスではブラスファミー: After completing the build, keep improving it by refining Spectres and jewels. Against pinnacle bosses, dropping Blasphemy and self-casting Despair raises damage (per the source guide's FAQ).
バインドスペクターで束縛したヴァールガード、スケルトンリーバー、プレイグハーヴェ: A minion army built around Spectres bound with Bind Spectre: Vaal Guard, then Skeletal Reaver, then Plague Harvester. Into the Breach Remnants are narrowed to added chaos damage with Choice of Power and passed to the minions with Selfless Remnants to scale damage. Level with a crossbow and Explosive Grenade early on, then switch to minions late in Act 3.
300+元素DPSの棘のタリスマン（Spiny Talisman、5〜20エグザ: A Spiny Talisman with 300+ elemental DPS (about 5-20 Exalted Orbs, plus 10-20 more Exalted Orbs of extra investment). Basic gear of 1-2 Exalted Orbs per slot. After taking Way of the Stonefist, choose gloves by the mod priority critical damage, then base critical chance, then attack speed, then Onslaught on hit (per the source guide).
380+元素DPSで近接／攻撃スキルレベル＋付きのタリスマン（10〜50エグザル: A talisman with 380+ elemental DPS and + to melee or attack skill levels (10-50 Exalted Orbs, optionally 1-2 Divine Orbs). Upgrade skill gems with Uncut Skill Gems (levels 17-18). Engrave the amulet with Thaumaturgic Generator. Greatly raise survivability with Forgotten Warden. Use Time-Lost Jewels, prioritising critical chance and critical damage (per the source guide).
3つ目のアセンダンシーは石拳の道（Way of the Stonefist）。武: Take Way of the Stonefist as the third Ascendancy. Weapon set 1 takes attack nodes; weapon set 2 takes parry nodes that strengthen Refutation (per the source guide).
490+元素DPS・クリティカル率15%以上・スキルレベル＋付きのタリスマン。ア: A talisman with 490+ elemental DPS, 15% or more critical chance and + to skill levels. Aim for 150% item rarity. Boots with 35% or more movement speed, evasion and Deflect. Update Forgotten Warden to a better roll. Gems at levels 19-20 with 20% quality (per the source guide).
4つ目のアセンダンシーはルーンの経絡（Runic Meridians）。クリティ: Take Runic Meridians as the fourth Ascendancy. Fill in critical nodes to raise critical chance. On Time-Lost Jewels, prioritise critical chance and critical damage (1-2 mods; the radius does not matter at this stage) (per the source guide).
5Modジュエルと4〜5Modタイムロストジュエルでクリティカル率・クリティカル: Fill in critical chance and critical damage with 5-mod jewels and 4-5-mod Time-Lost Jewels. Raise jewels to 20% quality (per the source guide).
Act 2（Lv22前後）でストームウェーブ（Storm Wave）に切り替え、: Switch to Storm Wave in Act 2 (around level 22) and clear by detonating Frozen Locus. Freeze single targets with Wave of Frost, then consume the freeze with Glacial Cascade's big spike for heavy damage. Add Herald of Thunder in Act 3.
Aspirational装備は長期目標で、リーグ中の大半の期間をかけて集めるもの: Aspirational gear is a long-term goal, gathered over most of the league (per the source guide). The spirits' Japanese names are unconfirmed on poe2db, so they are shown in English (see the research report).
DPSの高いマジック／レアのクォータースタッフ。移動速度10%以上のブーツ。ライ: A magic or rare quarterstaff with high DPS. Boots with 10% or more movement speed. Helmet, body armour and belt with plenty of Life. You may use an Artificer's Orb to socket the weapon and reinforce it with Lesser Runes (per the source guide).
Early Mapsの構成に加え、オイルバラージにクリティカル集中（50%未満の: In addition to the Early Maps setup, add Pinpoint Critical to Oil Barrage (while below 50% critical chance; switch to Elemental Armament II above 50%). Add Perpetual Charge to Rend. Add Prolonged Duration II to Hollow Focus. Add Charged Mark to Hand of Chayula. Add Prolonged Duration II to Refutation. Give Spirit Vessel Oil Barrage, Potent Exposure, Hulking Minions, Romira's Requital and Amanamu's Tithe.

Lv13でホロウパームテクニックを取得し、Act 1を進める。: Take Hollow Palm Technique at level 13 and continue through Act 1.
Lv14〜キャンペーン終了（ストームウェーブ育成）: Levels 14 to End of Campaign (Storm Wave Leveling)
Lv1〜13（ホロウパーム育成・Act 1前半）: Levels 1-13 (Hollow Palm Leveling, First Half of Act 1)
Lv21ジェム・ラキアタの流れ・ザロークの贈り物など長期目標に進む準備ができたら: Move to Aspirational once you are ready for long-term goals such as level 21 gems, Rakiata's Flow and Zarokh's Gift.

Lv77以上になり、タリスマンを380+元素DPSへ更新できる。アミュレットにソ: Reach level 77 or higher and update the talisman to 380+ elemental DPS. Engrave the amulet with Thaumaturgic Generator.
オイルバラージ Lv21・品質0%（ラキアタの流れ使用時）。チャユラの手からエレ: Oil Barrage at level 21 and 0% quality (when using Rakiata's Flow). Remove Elemental Weakness from Hand of Chayula and remove Oil Barrage from Spirit Vessel (the source guide's instruction for the Rakiata's Flow setup). You may use Hand of Chayula instead of Pounce. For mapping, you can switch to a Blasphemy and Repulsion setup instead (in that case, drop Refutation and add +50 Spirit on the body armour).
オイルバラージ— パワーチャージを消費して連鎖・分岐・ノヴァの投射物を放つ。ホロ: Oil Barrage consumes Power Charges to fire chaining, forking and Nova projectiles. Generate Power Charges by consuming Hollow Focus bells and slain enemies' corpses with Devour. Level with Frozen Locus and Glacial Cascade early on, switch to Storm Wave from Act 2, and change to Oil Barrage in Early Maps.
オイルバラージが主軸のまま。クリティカル率50%以上になったらクリティカル集中（: Oil Barrage stays the main skill. Once critical chance passes 50%, replace Pinpoint Critical with Elemental Armament II. Put Oil Barrage in Spirit Vessel to raise single-target damage.
オイルバラージにラキアタの流れ（Rakiata's Flow）。チャユラの手に呪: Give Oil Barrage Rakiata's Flow. Add Eternal Mark to Hand of Chayula. Add Uhtred's Exodus to Charge Regulation. For mapping, give Blasphemy Repulsion, Living Lightning II, Culmination II, Ailith's Chimes and Charge Profusion II.
オイルバラージに元素武装 II（クリティカル集中は外す）。ホロウフォーカスにリビ: Give Oil Barrage Elemental Armament II (remove Pinpoint Critical). Give Hollow Focus Living Lightning II, Culmination II, Ailith's Chimes and Charge Profusion II. Add Rapid Attacks III to Rend. Add Mark for Death II to Hand of Chayula. Add Rapid Casting II to Refutation. Add Blind II to Wind Dancer. Spirit Vessel stays the same as in Late Maps.
オイルバラージに跳弾 II（Ricochet II）＋分岐（Fork）＋サルヴォ: Give Oil Barrage Ricochet II, Fork, Salvo and Nova Projectiles I. Give Rend Heightened Charges, Prolonged Duration II and Rage III. Give Hollow Focus Cooldown Recovery II, Magnified Area II and Overabundance II. Give Devour Blazing Critical, Thrill of the Kill II, Charge Profusion II and Rage III. Give Tempest Bell Ancestral Call II, Magnified Area II and Delayed Gratification. Give Whirling Assault Practiced Combo, Rage III and Rapid Attacks III. Give Hand of Chayula Freezing Mark, Elemental Weakness and Mark of Siphoning II. Give Refutation Cooldown Recovery II, Mobility and Efficiency II. Give Wind Dancer Magnified Area II, Stun III and Enduring Impact II. Give Ghost Dance Cooldown Recovery II and Clarity. Use Charge Regulation as a permanent buff.
オイルバラージ（Lv20・品質20%）。パワーチャージ生成はソーマタージー発生装: Oil Barrage (level 20, 20% quality). Power Charge generation becomes increasingly automatic with Thaumaturgic Generator, Way of the Stonefist gloves (Power Charge on critical hit) and Hollow Focus's Ailith's Chimes. Against bosses, place a Tempest Bell with Whirling Assault to raise single-target damage.
オイルバラージ（Oil Barrage）に切り替える。マップ開始時にホロウフォー: Switch to Oil Barrage. At the start of a map, consume a Hollow Focus bell with Devour to gain your first Power Charge, then clear with Oil Barrage. Keep consuming bells and slain enemies' corpses with Devour to maintain Power Charges. Place a Tempest Bell with Whirling Assault to add more chaining and forking origins.
キャンペーンをクリアし、Early Mapsに入る。300+元素DPSの棘のタリ: Clear the campaign and enter Early Maps. Prepare a Spiny Talisman with 300+ elemental DPS.
キャンペーン終盤にパッシブの振り直しが数か所ある。ゴールドが足りない場合はレア品: There are a few passive respecs near the end of the campaign. If you are short on gold, sell rares to save up (per the source guide).
クォータースタッフで進め、Lv2でフローズンローカス（Frozen Locus）: Progress with a quarterstaff. At level 2, place Frozen Locus and detonate it with Glacial Cascade's big spike. At level 6, add Pounce for movement, and at level 10, add Herald of Ice. At level 13, take Hollow Palm Technique, after which you no longer need a quarterstaff.
クリティカル率を100%に近づける。エネルギーシールドと回避・受け流しのバランス: Push critical chance toward 100%. Balance Energy Shield with evasion and Deflect. Fill in area-of-effect jewels (3-4-mod Time-Lost Jewels prioritising critical chance and critical damage, and jewels that increase suffix effects) (per the source guide).
グレイシャルカスケードに効果範囲集中（Concentrated Area）＋憤怒: Give Glacial Cascade Concentrated Area and Rage I. Give Frozen Locus Ice Bite. Give Herald of Ice Magnified Area.
グレイシャルカスケードのダメージは最後の大スパイクが大半を占める。フローズンロー: Most of Glacial Cascade's damage comes from the final big spike. To break Frozen Locus in one hit, land the big spike on it. Consuming a freeze adds a 250% or 425% damage multiplier (per the source guide).
ストームウェーブに憤怒 II（Rage II）＋元素武装 II（Elementa: Give Storm Wave Rage II, Elemental Armament II and Branching Fissures. Give Glacial Cascade Concentrated Area, Elemental Armament II and Elemental Focus. Give Frozen Locus Ice Bite II, Elemental Armament II and Innervate. Give Frost Bomb Potent Exposure. Give Herald of Ice Magnified Area II and Elemental Armament II. Give Hand of Chayula Freezing Mark and Elemental Weakness. Give Wave of Frost Deep Freeze and Ice Bite II. Give Pounce Cooldown Recovery II.
タリスマン490+元素DPS・クリティカル率15%以上、アイテムレアリティ150: Move to Endgame once the talisman reaches 490+ elemental DPS and 15% or more critical chance, item rarity approaches 150%, and gems reach levels 19-20 with 20% quality.
チャネリングの遅延はスキル速度で後半解消される（原典の短所）。「当たらない立ち回: The channelling delay is resolved by skill speed later on (a weakness listed in the source guide). This build assumes a 'don't get hit' playstyle, and some enemies such as Abyss monsters need high damage and area (per the source guide's FAQ).
ノヴァの投射物は必ず I を使う。II を付けると他のジェムが全部入らなくなる（: Always use Nova Projectiles I. Socketing tier II leaves no room for the other gems (a strong warning in the source guide). While critical chance is low, you can supplement Power Charge generation with a Blasphemy, Repulsion and Ailith's Chimes setup instead (at the cost of the Charge Regulation and Ghost Dance slots).
ホロウパームテクニックへ最速で進む。道中は効率の良い序盤ダメージノードを取る。装: Rush to Hollow Palm Technique as fast as possible. Take efficient early damage nodes along the way, and enough attributes to meet gear and gem requirements (per the source guide).
ヴェルシウムアンビル（Versium Anvil）で石の拳（Fists of S: Without converting Fists of Stone into Runeforged Fists of Stone at the Versium Anvil, Refutation cannot be used in the Forgotten Warden Spirit Vessel setup (per the source guide). Do not use Refutation while clearing (it causes heavy stuns).
完成形。以後はジュエルの多Mod化と各装備の最大ロール化、タイムロストジュエルの: Completed build. From here, work on multi-mod jewels, max rolls on each piece of gear, and strict Time-Lost Jewel selection.
武器セット2（パウンス用）のポイント配分を始める。最初のアセンダンシーは山の道（: Start allocating points for weapon set 2 (for Pounce). Take Ascendancy points in the order Way of the Mountain, then Hollow Focus Technique. Near the end of the campaign there is a respec toward strong scaling nodes for the move to maps (per the source guide's note).
購入可能な最高元素DPS（または物理DPS）のタリスマン（クリティカル率15%以: The highest elemental DPS (or physical DPS) talisman you can buy (15% or more critical chance, attack speed and + to skill levels). Put a Raven-Touched Shard on the helmet, and change the amulet engraving from Thaumaturgic Generator to Zarokh's Gift. Keep item rarity at 150% or higher. For Rite of Passage spirits, prioritise Spirit of the Stag (movement speed, skill speed and added lightning damage) first, then Spirit of the Cat (critical chance and evasion), Spirit of the Wolf (movement speed, skill speed and armour break), Spirit of the Owl (Energy Shield and damage), and Spirit of the Bear (maximum Life and reduced damage taken), in that order (per the source guide).
近接スキルレベル＋のグローブ・アミュレット、攻撃への元素フラットダメージのリング: Gloves and amulet with + to melee skill levels, and rings with flat elemental damage to attacks. Prioritise Life and resistances. Boots with 20-30% movement speed. When trading, Horns of Bynden and Luminous Pace are early options (per the source guide).

Before getting Snakepit, level with Ice Nova (clearing) and Frost Darts (single target), and switch to Frostbolt once you can equip Snakepit at Lv32.
アイスノヴァ（Ice Nova）でクリアし、フロストダーツ（Frost Dart: Clear with Ice Nova and wear down single targets with Frost Darts. Create cold Infusion Remnants with Frost Bomb and Snap to empower Ice Nova and Frost Darts. Move with Pounce; keep Arctic Armour as a permanent buff.
アイスノヴァ＋フロストダーツの育成を継続し、エレメンタルウィークネス（Eleme: Keep leveling with Ice Nova and Frost Darts, and lower enemy resistances with Elemental Weakness. Update Frost Bomb's supports to Spell Echo.
フロストウォール（Frost Wall）で氷の結晶を作り、サイフォンエレメント（: Create ice crystals with Frost Wall, and freeze enemies with Siphon Elements to collect cold Infusion. Give Frost Darts Elemental Focus and Cold Penetration to raise single-target damage.
クリティカル時キャスト（Cast on Critical）にコメット（Comet: Put Comet and Living Bomb in Cast on Critical so critical hits automatically drop Comets. Freeze enemies with Ice Nova and break Frost Wall crystals to build energy. For single targets, debuff with Sigil of Power and Elemental Weakness first.
フロストボルト（Frostbolt）に切り替える。スネークピットで貫通が分岐に変: Switch to Frostbolt. Snakepit turns its pierce into fork, so overlapping explosions clear packs. Break Frost Wall crystals with Frostbolt to fire Comets repeatedly through Cast on Critical. Raise Comet to Lv21. Add Convalescence as a recovery tool.
カオスイノキュレーション（Chaos Inoculation）へ移行し、ライフ1: Transition to Chaos Inoculation and fight with 1 Life and an ES-focused "blue Life". Frostbolt stays the main skill. Add Boundless Energy II to the second Cast on Critical to speed up Comet rotation. Move with Blink, and sustain with Remnants of Kalguur and Mana Remnants. The planner also has a Spark variant as an alternative to Frostbolt.
アイスノヴァに破壊制御＋効果範囲拡大＋熟考詠唱（Considered Casti: Give Ice Nova Controlled Destruction, Magnified Area and Considered Casting. Give Frost Darts Controlled Destruction and Considered Casting. Give Frost Bomb Overabundance and Spell Echo. Give Snap Magnified Area and Controlled Destruction. Give Elemental Weakness Heightened Curse and Efficiency.
アイスノヴァに破壊制御（Controlled Destruction）＋効果範囲: Give Ice Nova Controlled Destruction and Magnified Area. Give Frost Darts Controlled Destruction and Rapid Casting. Give Frost Bomb Overabundance and Spell Cascade. Give Snap Magnified Area and Controlled Destruction.

Give Frost Bomb Overabundance, Spell Echo, Potent Exposure and Cooldown Recovery II. Give Elemental Weakness Efficiency II, Prolonged Duration II, Heightened Curse and Cursed Ground. Give Convalescence Second Wind III, Prolonged Duration II and Cooldown Recovery II. Give Sigil of Power Prolonged Duration II, Cooldown Recovery II and Magnified Area II. Give Cast on Critical Comet at Lv21, Efficiency II, Elemental Focus, Concentrated Area and Boundless Energy II. Give Spark Pierce III, Vilenta's Propulsion, Rakiata's Flow, Efficiency II and Ice Bite II. アイスノヴァに効果範囲拡大 II＋アストラルプロジェクション＋スーパークリティカ: Give Ice Nova Magnified Area II, Astral Projection, Supercritical and Rising Tempest. Give Frost Darts Elemental Focus, Considered Casting, Supercritical and Cold Penetration. Give Frost Wall Spell Cascade, Icicle, Cooldown Recovery II and Fortress. Act 1〜2で45ノード。凍結の上限（Frozen Limit）とインフューズ: 45 nodes by Acts 1–2. Raise the Infusion cap with Frozen Limit and Infused Limits (per the source guide's FAQ). Take efficient cold damage and Life nodes along the way.
Act 3で68ノードへ。冷気ダメージとクリティカルへ進み、Act 3のフロスト: 68 nodes by Act 3. Head toward cold damage and critical, preparing for the Frost Wall addition in Act 3 (per the source planner).
Act 4で76ノード、幕間で112ノードへ。冷気ダメージ・クリティカル・ライフ: 76 nodes in Act 4, 112 in the Interlude. Raise cold damage, critical, Life and ES (per the source planner).
Mapsで140ノード。交錯する現実（Entwined Realities）など: 140 nodes in Maps. Take Oracle ascendancy nodes such as Entwined Realities plus many keystones (per the source guide's summary).
CI＋フロストボルトで145〜146ノード。カオスイノキュレーションへの移行準備: 145–146 nodes with CI + Frostbolt. Raise ES to prepare for the Chaos Inoculation transition (per the source planner).
Min Maxで159ノード。交錯する現実と多数のキーストーンを活かし、クリティ: 159 nodes at Min Max. Use Entwined Realities and many keystones to push critical chance, critical damage and ES (per the source planner and summary).
ライフと耐性の多いマジック／レア装備。冷気スペルダメージのワンド＋フォーカス。移: Magic/rare gear with plenty of Life and resistances. A wand + focus with cold spell damage. Boots with movement speed (per the source guide's FAQ on defenses).
引き続きライフ＋耐性優先。Act 4からES値の高い知性装備へ切り替え始める（原: Keep prioritizing Life and resistances. From Act 4, start switching to high-ES Intelligence gear (per the source guide's FAQ).
ES値の高い知性装備へ切り替え始める。ライフ＋ESハイブリッドを維持する（原典）: Start switching to high-ES Intelligence gear. Keep a Life + ES hybrid (per the source guide).
マナ：キル時最大マナ2%回復のジュエル2個を用意する（原典FAQ）。ワンド＋フォ: Mana: prepare two jewels with 2% of maximum Mana recovered on kill (per the source guide's FAQ). Update the wand + focus toward cold spell levels and critical chance (per the source guide's summary).
左リングにスネークピット（分岐の中核）を装備する。ワンド＋フォーカスは冷気スペル: Equip Snakepit in the left ring (the fork core). Prioritize cold spell levels and critical chance on the wand + focus (per the source guide's summary).
テンポラリス（胴）、カランドラの接触（リング）、メイジブラッド（ベルト）、ルーン: Temporalis (body), Kalandra's Touch (ring), Mageblood (belt), Runeseeker's Call (weapon), Nascent Hope and Rite of Passage (charms), Time-Lost Sapphire (area + critical damage) (per the source planner's Min Maxed setup).
フロストボルトはスネークピットなしでは機能しない。アイスノヴァとフロストダーツは: Frostbolt does not work without Snakepit. Ice Nova and Frost Darts lose a lot of damage without cold Infusion, so collect Remnants with Frost Bomb and Snap (per the source guide).
インフュージョンは最大3スタックまで。凍結の上限とインフューズの限界で上限を上げ: Infusion stacks up to 3. Raise the cap with Frozen Limit and Infused Limits (per the source guide's FAQ).
Act 1〜3は防御手段が少ない。ライフと耐性を伸ばし、フロストウォールを防御に: Defenses are thin in Acts 1–3. Raise Life and resistances, and use Frost Wall defensively as well (per the source guide's FAQ).
コメット1発に300エネルギーが必要。通常モンスターのクリティカルは1エネルギー: One Comet needs 300 energy. A critical hit on a normal monster generates only 1 energy, so Comet stalls when few enemies are frozen (per the source guide's FAQ).

Break Frost Wall crystals with Frostbolt to fire Comets repeatedly through Cast on Elemental Ailment / Cast on Critical. Before getting Snakepit, level with Ice Nova (clearing) and Frost Darts (single target), and switch to Frostbolt once you can equip Snakepit at Lv32. The Disciple of Varashta ascendancy Instruments of Power lets you use a staff and focus together, and Baryanic Leylines widens the area of Time-Lost Sapphires.
